prompts.title: Detailed Pencil Sketch of Man in Flat Cap
prompts.prompt:
Create a highly detailed black-and-white graphite and ink portrait sketch of a man wearing a dark classic flat cap, rectangular eyeglasses, and a dark, heavy high-collared jacket. Show him in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to the right, with a serious, calm expression.
Capture realistic facial proportions, prominent nose, deep-set eyes behind the glasses, thick eyebrows, detailed hair visible beneath the cap. Render the hair, eyebrows, and skin with extremely fine individual strokes.
Use a micro-detail hand-drawn sketch style with layered graphite shading, cross-hatching, fine contour lines, loose construction strokes, and subtle white pencil highlights. Add detailed linework to the fabric folds, raised collar, buttons, cap texture, and eyeglass frames. Maintain visible sketch strokes rather than a perfectly polished digital illustration.
Lighting: A soft directional light comes from the right side of the image, gently illuminating the right side of the face, and coat, creating subtle highlights and enhanced facial definition. The opposite side remains slightly darker with soft, natural graphite shading.
Use a light gray textured paper background, monochrome grayscale tones, strong but natural contrast, subtle shadows, and an authentic traditional pencil-and-ink drawing appearance.
Style: ultra-detailed graphite portrait, monochrome pencil sketch, super-fine cross-hatching, realistic hand-drawn linework, micro-detail, textured paper, editorial portrait illustration, highly refined traditional sketch, 8K detail. Aspect ratio 4:5.

prompts.title: Ballpoint Pen Drawing of Handsome Male
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-detailed micro-detail blue ink portrait of a handsome man, rendered entirely with extremely fine ballpoint-pen style strokes on clean white paper. Show a chest-up, three-quarter portrait, with the head slightly turned to the side and the subject gazing thoughtfully toward the right.
Capture the face with exceptional precision: sharp facial details, expressive deep-set eyes, naturally shaped eyebrows, detailed lips, and subtle skin pores and natural facial lines. Reproduce every facial contour using thousands of tiny blue-ink hatching, cross-hatching, stippling, and delicate line strokes.
The hair should be highly detailed and voluminous, with individual flowing strands, layered strokes, loose flyaway hairs, and realistic directional texture. Make the eyes especially intricate with tiny iris details and subtle ink shading.
He is wearing a classic open-collar button-up shirt, with realistic fabric folds and fine parallel ink lines. Use dense micro-hatching around the neck, jaw, hair, and shadow areas while keeping the highlights mostly untouched white paper.
Style: traditional hand-drawn ballpoint pen / fine-liner ink illustration, monochromatic deep blue ink, extremely intricate micro-linework, realistic cross-hatching, stippling, fine contour lines, controlled tonal gradients, delicate imperfections of handmade drawing, museum-quality pen portrait.
Background: completely clean white paper, minimal and uncluttered, with no objects or scenery.
Lighting & Detail: subtle directional lighting represented entirely through ink density, extremely high line precision, realistic skin texture, dimensional facial shading, crisp edges, intricate hair strands, micro-details visible even when zoomed in, authentic hand-drawn appearance. Aspect ratio: 4:5 vertical, centered portrait, 8K high-resolution.

prompts.title: Blue Ink Reverie
prompts.prompt:
Create a highly detailed vintage blue-ink pen-and-ink illustration of a stylish man sitting relaxed in a vast wildflower meadow. He is seated on the grass with one leg extended toward the foreground and the other bent, creating a dynamic perspective. He wears a sophisticated dark tailored blazer over a partially unbuttoned dress white shirt, paired with dark trousers and dark polished leather shoes. One hand rests naturally on his raised knee while the other rests near his extended leg. His head is tilted slightly upward, eyes gently closed, with a joyful, peaceful expression.
Render the entire artwork using fine dark-blue ballpoint pen linework, with intricate cross-hatching, parallel hatching, stippling, contour lines, and dense micro-details to create realistic depth, shadows, fabric texture, hair strands, and facial anatomy. Preserve natural facial proportions and expressive features.
The setting is an expansive countryside meadow filled with numerous delicate wildflowers and tall grasses, extending into rolling hills and distant layered landscapes. Use detailed botanical linework throughout the foreground, with smaller flowers and softer cross-hatched details toward the horizon. Keep the sky mostly clean and lightly textured, providing strong negative space around the subject.
Art style: vintage fashion illustration, hand-drawn blue ink engraving, detailed pen sketch, editorial illustration, botanical line-art aesthetic, realistic anatomy, extremely intricate cross-hatching and stippling, monochromatic deep navy-blue ink on warm off-white textured paper, elegant and timeless.
Composition: vertical full-body portrait, low-to-mid eye-level perspective, subject centered, extended shoe prominent in the foreground for subtle forced perspective, generous background landscape, balanced visual hierarchy, highly detailed throughout. Aspect ratio 4:5.

prompts.title: The Cafe Window
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image strictly only for the woman’s facial identity and natural features. Preserve her face shape, facial proportions, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, skin tone, and overall likeness accurately. Keep her natural hair color from the reference, but style it as described below.
Create a high-resolution traditional blue ballpoint pen (Biro) illustration on lightly textured warm off-white paper, in a vertical 4:5 composition. The image should look hand-drawn with refined navy-blue ink linework, realistic pen pressure variation, delicate contour lines, dense cross-hatching, and visible paper grain. Add a subtle warm sepia/golden sunlight tint entering from the right side, blending naturally with the cool blue ink shadows.
Show the woman seated at a wooden café table in a three-quarter side composition. Her body is angled slightly toward the left while her face is turned toward the right, gazing pensively out of frame with a quiet, thoughtful expression. One elbow rests on the tabletop and the matching hand gently supports her cheek and chin; her other arm rests naturally across her lap. Her pose should feel relaxed, candid, and emotionally reflective.
Give her a messy loose bun/updo with fluid overlapping ink strokes, softly textured strands, and a few natural loose tendrils around her temples, cheeks, and neck. She wears a loose dark short-sleeve t-shirt and dark pants, rendered with rich near-solid navy ink, deep folds, and dense multidirectional cross-hatching. Keep her face softly luminous with sparse fine hatching, expressive eyes, defined lashes, natural brows, a straight nose, and softly parted full lips.
In front of her, place an open spiral-bound notebook on the wooden plank table. Fill the pages with small illegible handwritten notes and abstract sketches only, with no readable words. Add a small geometric triangle-like diagram on one page and a dark blue pen placed diagonally across the notebook. To the right, include an open zippered pencil pouch with several pens visible inside. Behind the notebook, place a white ceramic coffee mug on a saucer with a small spoon and subtle rising steam drawn using thin, soft negative-space lines.
Use visible wood grain, plank gaps, and linear hatching across the tabletop, with the warm sunlight becoming more prominent toward the right edge. Seat her on a slatted wooden chair with curved ink hatching and realistic structure.
Create a softly detailed café background: a bright window on the right as the source of warm light, wooden cabinetry and potted plants on the left, a hanging plant or pendant lamp above, and a distant café guest seated with their back turned near the window. Keep all background elements lighter, softer, and less densely drawn than the woman and table objects, creating natural atmospheric depth and focus separation.
The woman, notebook, mug, and pencil pouch should have crisp, high-contrast, highly detailed blue ink lines. The background should remain airy and understated. Let the portrait and surrounding linework softly dissolve and fade into the paper around all four outer edges of the composition, especially near the corners and border, so the image blends naturally into the off-white paper instead of ending with hard defined edges. No photorealistic colors, no painted brushstrokes, no cartoon look, no thick black outlines, no readable text, no distorted hands, no extra fingers, no overly smooth skin.

prompts.title: The Scribble Sketch Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Create a 8K highly detailed head-and-neck portrait illustration of a person. Use the attached image as the ONLY face-matching reference.
Composition:
The composition includes the subject's head and shoulders, perfectly composed and perfectly centered. Maintain balanced negative space around the head and hair. The subject is looking directly into the camera with a strict eye-level, front-facing angle (no tilt). Expression should be calm, composed, and with lips gently closed. The subject is wearing a simple black round neck T-shirt, visible only at the shoulders and neckline.
Art Style:
Render the artwork as a raw, chaotic ink-style poster, constructed primarily from dense, curved black scribble strokes. The reference image is used strictly for accurate structure and likeness—do not stylize beyond recognition.
Line Work & Form:
Build hair, facial shadows, and depth using layered, overlapping, uneven lines
Incorporate rough cross-hatching techniques
Lines should feel organic, tangled, expressive, and slightly imperfect
Embrace a sense of controlled chaos and hand-drawn energy
Color Palette (Strictly Minimal):
Skin: flat beige tone only (no gradients, no realism)
Structure & shading: deep black ink strokes only
No smooth blending or polished rendering
Stylistic Details:
Introduce slight asymmetry in line flow for a natural, raw feel
Surround the subject with an irregular, abstract tangled aura made of loose scribbles
Enhance the chaotic energy while maintaining structural clarity
Background:
A solid, flat, vibrant yellow background, clean and uniform, creating strong contrast with the black ink work
Lighting:
Lighting should be implied only through line density—do not use realistic lighting or shading techniques
Overall Look:
High-contrast, graphic, poster-like aesthetic with a raw, expressive ink illustration style
Strictly Avoid:
3D effects
Realistic rendering
Gradients
Soft shading
Any polished or clean digital finish
Style Direction:
Expressive ink illustration / raw sketch poster / abstract line-art portrait
Output Quality:
8K resolution
Aspect Ratio: 4:5

prompts.title: Man in Suit Sketch Prompt
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image strictly ONLY for face matching and identity reference. Preserve exact facial structure, proportions, eye shape, nose structure, sharpness, grooming, and natural asymmetry.
Pose & Composition
Subject is seated upright with a straight spine.
Neck perfectly straight, head level and centered, facing directly forward.
Aspect ratio: 4:5.
Framing: Upper-chest to slightly above head shot.
Face centered, head occupying approximately 75–80% of the frame.
Minimal upper shoulder visibility. 
Expression:
Neutral intense expression, eyes directly at camera, lips closed, subtle tension in eyes and brow.
Hair:
Hair is thick and natural with realistic flow, slight irregularity, believable strand direction using sharp ink strokes. Rendered with fine directional strokes, maintaining skin texture through linework.
Outfit:
He wears a tailored black suit blazer (worn open) over a crisp white button-down dress shirt with a slim black tie.  matte fabric, subtle folds near neck and shoulders, rendered using cross-hatching (not flat black fill).
Style:
Ultra-detailed black-and-white ink engraving illustration. Heavy cross-hatching and line-based shading, varied stroke density and direction to define facial planes, scratch lines, etched strokes, and raw ink texture for a hand-drawn feel. Subtle bottom splash effect applied to the lower edge of the portrait to smoothly fade shoulders into background.
Lighting:
Strong chiaroscuro using line density (no gradients). One side of face slightly darker, deep shadows under cheekbones, jawline, eye sockets, and neck. No soft lighting.
Background:
Clean off-white with minimal ink splatter around edges only. No environment.
Camera & Lens:
Eye-level camera angle, 85mm perspective.
Avoid:
Anime, cartoon, soft shading, gradients, 3D, CGI, photorealism, color, glow, blur, smooth skin, beautified face, generic face, over-stylized hair, perfect symmetry, detailed background, logos, text, accessories, vector art.
